interpretation: The native local dispatch reproduces the observed original task hashes and all four saved new-task episode batches exactly.

Changing only NumPy dispatch availability can change Duffing floating-point outputs while leaving episode/origin indices unchanged. The power(x,3) primitive probe specifically demonstrates a kernel-dependent last-bit difference.
Small numerical differences still fail the unchanged exact generator-replay check; numerical closeness is not a passed bitwise audit.
Saved archive/input hashes and bitwise generation are separate reproducibility properties. This diagnostic does not modify saved inputs, hashes, outcomes, or frozen audit rules.
Disabling AVX512 globally is not a repair for these recorded hashes. Matching package versions and OS alone does not guarantee matching CPU-selected kernels.
A compatible numerical environment is required for full strict replay. Sampled primitive equality for cosine/sine/tanh does not prove equality for every possible input.
